ov: About 4,600 species of flat-bodied insects, only about 30 of which live around people. Termites evolved from within the cockroaches. Cockroaches are among the hardiest insects.
rg: Worldwide, from Arctic cold to tropical heat; tropical species are often much larger.
df: Omnivores. The American cockroach eats bread, fruit, leather, book-binding starch, glue, hair and dead insects.
fx: Some species stay active for a month without food, and some can go 45 minutes without air.
